issue.title: Formatter - Date and timezone issue

repository.name: yii2
repository.description: Yii 2: The Fast, Secure and Professional PHP Framework

issue.body:
There is a issue in formatter where returned formatted date has a wrong value.

Prerequisite: current date in UTC and your local timezone should be different.

Code example:
`echo Yii::$app->formatter->asDate('2014-10-09', 'php:Y-m-d');`

Expected result is: `2014-10-09`
Real result is: `2014-10-10`

Problem is in formatter as it assumes the input date was in UTC timezone and then formats it in the local timezone (or whatever you have set in your app). This may be the correct way to handle it in some cases but for example in DatePicker widget it's definitely not.

Previous example of the problem description: https://github.com/yiisoft/yii2/issues/5328#issuecomment-58434636

body: It's not working. I udpated app using composer today ant id stopped working. Run another update after I read this issue and #5448 but it doesn't help.

i've got similar exception after fresh composer update (previous was yesterday)
PHP 5.5.9-1ubuntu4.5  timezone setted in php.ini and in application`s config as 'Asia/Irkutsk'
Troubles comes with unixtimestamp format only

I can see in yii\i18n\DateTimeExtended at 69 line `$originalDateTime->getTimezone()` the $originalDateTime object has the timezone set to +00:00. When I make `$originalDateTime = new DateTime()` the timezone is set to UTC and then setting the timezone is working fine.

The problem still exists. I think timezone should be set after `parent::createFromFormat(...` in order to set the timezone properly. Calling `parent::createFromFormat($format, $time, $timezone)` will not set the timezone anyway (to UTC for example).

If I set timezone after createFromFormat exception is gone.
Debug page `/index.php?r=debug` dosn't work because of this :(

> $originalDateTime->setTimezone($timezone);

this is not entirely correct because the parsed date may have a timezone already set. We need to get timezone information ourselfs from the parsed input to fix this... It's fine as a workaround though
ignoring timezone parameter by createFromFormat method is a php [bug](https://bugs.php.net/bug.php?id=53833&edit=1) with status "Won't fix".

> ignoring timezone parameter by createFromFormat method is a php bug with status "Won't fix".
